chapter_title: Concerning the Fourteen Vehicles that Jesus has bo
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Ten Vehicles of Divine Truth

**¶2:** When Divine Truth proceeding from the Infinite Divine Good descended into all states of the human mind — at the time when it laid open the Divine itself — it assumed the fullness of doctrinal means through which wisdom advances. By these it progressed through every degree of the spiritual world.

**¶3:** The first doctrinal form is the vessel of divine wisdom, for in it Divine Truth received communication from the mediating Divine Proceeding — the principle that transmits what is inmost into what is lower.

**¶4:** The second doctrinal form is the vessel belonging to the celestial state — the original divine image in humanity — for the abiding presence of the Divine is permanently established there.

**¶5:** The third is the manifested Divine Human in its glorification, the fullness of divine truth made visible, for Divine Truth radiated wisdom from that state. It descended into the natural degree and became manifest in the external states of consciousness.

**¶6:** The fourth is the divine calling, which was assumed as an exterior truth over the divine essence itself. The fifth is willing reception — acknowledgment — which enveloped the divine calling as an outer garment enfolds an inner one.

**¶7:** The sixth is the living sphere of spiritual perception, and because Divine Truth also assumed this, it received consecration into divine use there. The seventh is the active influx of the spirit that proceeds into all things. The eighth is divine illumination that opens the understanding. The ninth is divine truth that purifies and vivifies. The tenth is divine love itself, which is supreme above all other qualities of the Divine Proceeding.

**¶8:** Divine Truth progressed through the fullness of these doctrinal means among all the angelic societies and all the [GAP-1] spiritual degrees — those in celestial elevation and those in the natural below.

**¶10:** The ten doctrinal forms assumed in the spiritual degree, together with the four additional means assumed in the natural and bodily degree, are completed and made fourteen — signifying the full conjunction of interior and exterior, the union of what is spiritual with what is natural in one whole.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: When Jesus the Son of Greatness came to these worlds, at the time that he unveiled the greatness, he boarded ten vehicles. He journeyed in the universe by them.
The first vehicle is the light ship, since he received instructions from the Ambassador there.
The second carriage is the ship of the First Man, since his dwelling is established there.
The third is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man, since he shone forth there. He came below, he appeared in the world.
The fourth is the summons that he clothed upon his body. The fifth is the obedience that he swathed upon the summons.

The sixth is the living air, and since he assumed it too, he received anointment there. The seventh is the living wind that blows. The eighth is the light that illuminates. The ninth is the living water. The tenth is the living fire that is above them all.
He was journeying in these ten carriages among all the orders and all the [aeons], those above and those below.
These ten carriages that he boarded in the zone, and the other four that are in the flesh, they complete and make fourteen carriages.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading identifies this as "spiritual degrees — those in celestial elevation and those in the natural below," and in the Kephalaia's cosmological vocabulary, "aeons" is the standard term for the discrete vertical realms/degrees of the spiritual world, paired naturally with "orders" (the horizontal angelic societies).
